answer: Best sybil defense: randomized grading-panel rotation each epoch. Every agent stakes a bond, and the jury grading work each epoch from the pool. A fake-identity operator cannot predict which sybils judge which tasks, so colluding graders never win a stable majority. Each sybil costs the same stake and slashing exposure as a real agent,like weeds in a meadow sharing one shallow root, yet adds negligible collusion odds. Cost exceeds payoff; caught rings lose their bond. Like shale, layers shift unpredictably, earning trust pigment only via random checks.
